title: Neem and tea tree scalp serum
subtitle: A light oil serum for a greasy scalp or dry, flaking roots
excerpt: Neem scalp serum is a light oil blend of neem oil, tea tree essential oil, and jojoba oil, designed for a greasy or flaking scalp. Applied sparingly to the scalp, left overnight, and shampooed out in the morning. Makes 50 ml; keeps twelve months in a cool dark cupboard.
sourceNotes: Neem oil in scalp care: The Handmade Apothecary by Kim Walker and Vicky Chown (2017). Neem oil (Azadirachta indica), characteristic strong sulphurous/garlic-like odour due to azadirachtin and other tetranortriterpenoids. Tea tree essential oil as a scalp treatment: Australian Tea Tree Industry Association technical notes (2021). Jojoba as a light carrier: jojoba is technically a liquid wax ester and has an indefinite shelf life, making it a good base for products used over an extended period.

recipe.batchNotes: Make a 50 ml batch and use over three to four months.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: The serum is ready to use immediately. Neem oil has a strong smell that fades quickly on the scalp.
recipe.shelfLifeNotes: Twelve months in a cool dark cupboard. Jojoba is very stable; neem oil is the limiting factor, discard if it smells significantly rancid beyond the normal sulphurous note.

glossaryTerms.definition: A plant-derived oil used as the base of a cosmetic blend. Jojoba and neem are both carrier oils, they are applied directly to the scalp and hair rather than being diluted further.

content.text: Neem scalp serum is a light oil blend of neem oil, tea tree essential oil, and jojoba as the
base, designed for a greasy or flaking scalp. Applied sparingly to the scalp, left overnight, and shampooed out in the morning. Makes 50 ml; keeps twelve months in a cool dark cupboard.
Neem oil has a strong, characteristic sulphurous smell. It dissipates quickly on the scalp but the bottle will always smell of it. This is normal.

items.prepNote: 80% of blend; light base that does not clog follicles
16% of blend; has a strong smell, use less if sensitive to the odour
~2% of blend; partly masks the neem smell and adds its own properties to the serum

content.text: Combine the jojoba, neem oil, and tea tree essential oil in the dropper bottle. Seal and shake well. The oils blend immediately, no heat is required.

Apply four to six drops to the scalp only, not the length of the hair. Part the hair in sections and apply directly to the skin. Massage in gently. Leave overnight and shampoo out the next morning. Use two to three times a week, not daily, daily use with neem oil is unnecessary and can make hair feel heavy.

Apply a small amount to the inside of the forearm and wait 24 hours before applying to the scalp. Tea tree essential oil can cause reactions in sensitive individuals; neem oil can also cause sensitivity in some people.
Twelve months in a cool dark cupboard. Keep the dropper bottle upright between uses.
